cells.gaps: R-CUN's trainees, more than 3,200 since 2022 by ANSUTEN's count of October 2026 (GIN-005), are not placed in more than one location; the training runs through ANSUTEN's Hub numérique. No source found since October 2023 gives a measured share of people with basic digital skills.
cells.note: ANSUTEN's R-CUN programme had trained more than 3,200 people by October 2026 and launched a fourth edition. No source places the counted training in more than one location, so not stage 3.
